Master toggle for ocean and beach (shoreline) waves. Turn off if you only want river waves, or no waves at all.
wavify.configuration.wave_opacity.toolti: How see-through the colored part of the wave is. Lower it to see what is under the waves.
wavify.configuration.foam_opacity.toolti: How see-through the white foam on top of the waves is.
wavify.configuration.wave_y_offset.toolt: Moves ocean and shoreline waves up or down. Negative = lower, closer to the water. Going too low hides waves washing up onto the beach.
Darkens the ground where a wave washes up, as if the sand got wet. Turn off to disable the effect entirely.
wavify.configuration.full_moon_glow.tool: Ocean waves glow at full brightness on full moon nights.
Master toggle for river waves. Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_spawn_ra: Radius (in blocks) around you within which river waves spawn. Larger = waves appear further away; smaller = only close by.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_y_offset: Moves river waves up or down. Negative = lower, closer to the water.
